title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – 24-month price basis proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to agree a 24-month basis for 23,700 kg per year, 47,400 kg in total.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

Our current price is EUR 5.84. Please consider the three attached packages, including one with your proposed AS-14404 clause. As the change exceeds 2%, could you submit them to your pricing committee for an authorised review?

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant or tolerance class would be possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 24-month price basis proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the index developments you cited and can accept your proposed 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause and 60-day payment terms. Building on this package, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.70 per unit.

For our baseline pricing, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

Our current commercial terms stand at a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our engineering team will contact you shortly to discuss whether a different tolerance class or variant is suitable for your requirements. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised packages, 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the revised offer of EUR 5.70. We can offer more commitment: all three packages below run for 36 months at 23,700 kg per year, 71,100 kg in total.

Our scorecard sc:70740@2026Q3 records an on-time delivery rate of 81.0%.

Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a change of +1.9% for this part.

As these prices are more than 2% below your quote, could you submit them to your pricing committee for an authorised review? Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation of hourly rates and material, and we would welcome that discussion. Could you also confirm your earliest lead time?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised packages, 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Following an internal review of your 36-month proposal, we can offer EUR 5.60 per unit for the package with 90-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. 

To give you the complete picture of our Angebot, we are offering a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While our internal cost breakdown and hourly rates remain confidential, we would be glad to schedule a meeting to discuss the index application and your volume forecast.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 – 36-month basis, fixed-price option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer of EUR 5.60. We are close to agreement.

All three packages below run for 36 months at 23,700 kg per year, 71,100 kg in total, with 90-day payment terms. This makes us one of the volume customers your sales director said you want to focus on.

Two packages offer a fixed price without the AS-14404 clause. This gives both sides a simple, stable basis. The third keeps your clause at a correspondingly lower base price.

Could you please submit these packages to your pricing committee for an authorised review? Would a fixed price at EUR 5.60 be acceptable as your primary standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 36-month basis, fixed-price option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always value our relationship and working closely with you. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We maintain our offer of a price of €5.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We cannot offer a fixed price over a 36-month term, so the AS-14404 index clause must remain to manage material cost fluctuations. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

You mentioned becoming a focus volume customer; please provide the specific data supporting this classification. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 36-month basis, fixed-price option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your business. As a reliable partner for high-quality steel products, our team remains at your disposal for all your supply needs from our extensive product range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
